name: deepfamily
description: DeepFamily - Decentralized Digital Family Tree Protocol

scripts.pages:build: npm ci --workspace deepfamily-frontend --workspace @deepfamily/proof-core --include-workspace-root=false --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --workspace deepfamily-frontend
scripts.test:gas: node -e "console.error('test:gas is not available after Hardhat 3 migration (hardhat-gas-reporter is Hardhat 2-only).'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.test:coverage: node -e "console.error('test:coverage is not available after Hardhat 3 migration (solidity-coverage is Hardhat 2-only).'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.contracts:check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run size && npm run storage:check && npm test
scripts.frontend:check: npm run frontend:lint && npm run frontend:legacy-entrypoints && npm run frontend:typecheck && npm run frontend:build && npm run frontend:test
scripts.check: npm run frontend:check && npm run contracts:check
scripts.dev:contract: npm run dev:deploy && npm run dev:fund && npm run dev:seed
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n node,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:node" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8545 && npm run dev:contract && npm run frontend:config && npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.zk:fetch: bash -lc 'set -e; mkdir -p bin; curl -sSL -o bin/circom https://github.com/iden3/circom/releases/download/v2.1.6/circom-linux-amd64 && chmod +x bin/circom && bin/circom --version'
scripts.zk:build:person: bash -lc 'set -e; mkdir -p zk-artifacts/circuits && bin/circom circuits/person_commitment.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -l node_modules -l node_modules/circomlib/circuits -o zk-artifacts/circuits'
scripts.zk:build:disclosure: bash -lc 'set -e; mkdir -p zk-artifacts/circuits && bin/circom circuits/disclosure_binding.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -l node_modules -l node_modules/circomlib/circuits -o zk-artifacts/circuits'
scripts.zk:build: npm run zk:build:person && npm run zk:build:disclosure
scripts.zk:ptau: snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 13 tmp/pot13_0000.ptau -v && snarkjs powersoftau contribute tmp/pot13_0000.ptau tmp/pot13_0001.ptau --name="init" -v -e="entropy1" && snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 tmp/pot13_0001.ptau tmp/pot13_final.ptau -v
scripts.zk:setup:person: snarkjs groth16 setup zk-artifacts/circuits/person_commitment.r1cs tmp/pot13_final.ptau zk-artifacts/circuits/person_commitment_0000.zkey && snarkjs zkey contribute zk-artifacts/circuits/person_commitment_0000.zkey zk-artifacts/circuits/person_commitment_final.zkey --name="1st" -v -e="entropy2" && snarkjs zkey export verificationkey zk-artifacts/circuits/person_commitment_final.zkey zk-artifacts/circuits/person_commitment.vkey.json
scripts.zk:setup:disclosure: snarkjs groth16 setup zk-artifacts/circuits/disclosure_binding.r1cs tmp/pot13_final.ptau zk-artifacts/circuits/disclosure_binding_0000.zkey && snarkjs zkey contribute zk-artifacts/circuits/disclosure_binding_0000.zkey zk-artifacts/circuits/disclosure_binding_final.zkey --name="1st" -v -e="entropy2" && snarkjs zkey export verificationkey zk-artifacts/circuits/disclosure_binding_final.zkey zk-artifacts/circuits/disclosure_binding.vkey.json
scripts.zk:setup: npm run zk:setup:person && npm run zk:setup:disclosure
scripts.zk:check: npm run zk:check:person && npm run zk:check:disclosure
scripts.zk:verifier:person: snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier zk-artifacts/circuits/person_commitment_final.zkey contracts/PersonCommitmentVerifier.sol && node scripts/rename-zk-verifier.mjs contracts/PersonCommitmentVerifier.sol PersonCommitmentVerifier
scripts.zk:verifier:disclosure: snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier zk-artifacts/circuits/disclosure_binding_final.zkey contracts/DisclosureBindingVerifier.sol && node scripts/rename-zk-verifier.mjs contracts/DisclosureBindingVerifier.sol DisclosureBindingVerifier
scripts.zk:verifier: npm run zk:verifier:person && npm run zk:verifier:disclosure
scripts.zk:refresh: npm run zk:build && npm run zk:setup && npm run zk:verifier && npm run zk:sync

author: DeepFamily Team
